entries.speaker: Special Orders
entries.en: In certain battles, you will be able to carry out[n]special orders. If these strategies succeed, the[n][clr 2]flow of battle will turn greatly in your favor[clr 27].

entries.speaker: Special Orders
entries.en: Be sure to choose the party member you[n]feel has the best chance of success.

entries.speaker: Special Orders
entries.en: However, keep in mind that this party member[n]will act separately, meaning you will have to[n]fight with [clr 2]one fewer party member[clr 27] for a[n]period of time.
